Karthikeyan Devadoss

Dear Hiring Team,

I am applying for the Forward Deployed Engineer, Enterprise role at Tavily. I have about ten years of backend engineering (Java/Spring since December 2016). Since early 2026 I have been one of a handful of engineers in NRG Energy's initial core AI team, designing and building AI solutions hands-on alongside my senior backend work, including production AI triage with Azure OpenAI, vector retrieval and a human approval step before any action, now used by several teams.

Separately, I independently designed and built a public agentic software-delivery platform with approval-gated agents, a deterministic vs LLM decision split, RAG with labelled retrieval evals and MCP tool boundaries. To be clear about where I stand: my title at NRG is Senior Backend Developer, and I have not held a customer-facing architect or forward-deployed title before. My architecture experience comes from taking part in design discussions and decisions with my lead, and from my own platform. I am based in Berlin and work in English.

Thank you for considering my application. I would welcome a conversation.

Kind regards,  
Karthikeyan Devadoss
